notes.title: Chains of Freedom – Update #1.0.3
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey, dear players![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience and all the valuable feedback you’ve shared in your reviews and forum posts! The wait is over – here’s the list of improvements in the latest build we’ve been working on:[/p][list][*][p]Added a much-requested Turn Limit toggle to Settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how ammunition is presented to the player: "ammo in clip / total clip capacity (inventory stock)".[/p][/*][*][p]Added exit prompts in areas that you cannot return to.[/p][/*][*][p]Raised loot discovery radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased ammo drops in most levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased material drops in multiple mid-game levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed or reduced enemy waves in many combat encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more Crystal slots in Places of Power after losing a character to compensate for lost quick slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Peacekeeper’s Overwatch ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted or removed specific tough enemies in some encounters to ease difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Added or adjusted loot during/after combat, especially extra ammo or consumables.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved quality-of-life mechanics, such as auto-removal of unused quest items and clearer indicators.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance and stability improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check it out and let us know what you think![/p]

notes.title: Chains of Freedom – Small Patch (April 23, 2025)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
 
This patch includes a few minor fixes. In the meantime, the team is actively working on addressing the feedback mentioned in the community for a future update.
 
Thanks for your support, and stay tuned!
